title: Protein Synthesis - Transcription and Translation
body: A DNA coding strand has the following sequence: 5'-ATG GCA TTC AAG TAA-3'. Determine the mRNA sequence that would be transcribed from this gene, and then use the genetic code to identify the amino acid sequence of the resulting polypeptide.
oer: Adapted from Siyavula Grade 12 Life Sciences - DNA: The Code of Life
